uncertain.note: The abbreviation is set in italic letters that look like Greek υυ. I wrote vv. (verben), as in most strips elsewhere in the book.
The breathing on ἦ is small and hard to read. I read it as smooth with a circumflex and no iota subscript.
No accent is visible on the ω of the genitive ending.
